sources.title: Kumo Relational Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Kumo Relational is a structured-data foundation model for prediction over relational, multi-table data. It uses declared schemas, relationships, entity tables, fact tables, context rows, and prediction rows without requiring callers to flatten connected tables into a single feature table.

sources.title: How Kumo Relational Works | NVIDIA Structured Data and Graph Models
sources.snippet: Kumo Relational is a pre-trained AI model that makes predictions from related database tables without requiring you to train a separate model for each task. You describe what to predict and for which entities in Predictive Query Language (PQL), then run the request against a Kumo Relational NVIDIA NIM, a packaged service that hosts the model for inference. sources.title: Overview | NVIDIA Structured Data and Graph Models
sources.snippet: Kumo Relational is a pre-trained relational foundation model: a model designed to make predictions from connected tables and examples supplied with each request. It works with structured, multi-table data without requiring you to train a separate model for each prediction task.
